title: Merge Ledger
summary: The lightweight ordering layer that sequences finalized lane tips into a single global history. Multiple lanes process transactions in parallel for throughput, and the merge ledger orders these lane tips into one canonical sequence without re-ordering finalized lane history, preserving both parallelism and consistency.
